triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly reports a bug where logChatCompression in packages/core/src/telemetry/loggers.ts bypasses bufferTelemetryEvent, unlike all other logging functions in the module. Concrete evidence, line numbers, and impact are provided.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The fix is a localized logic update in a single file (packages/core/src/telemetry/loggers.ts) wrapping existing code inside a bufferTelemetryEvent call, alongside corresponding test updates in packages/core/src/telemetry/loggers.test.ts.

summary.problem: logChatCompression in packages/core/src/telemetry/loggers.ts bypasses the bufferTelemetryEvent wrapper used by all other telemetry logging functions.
summary.root_cause: logChatCompression directly calls logger.emit and recordChatCompressionMetrics outside of bufferTelemetryEvent. If called before OpenTelemetry SDK initialization completes, events and metrics are emitted against a no-op provider and silently dropped.
summary.context: bufferTelemetryEvent buffers telemetry events until the OpenTelemetry SDK is initialized. Every other logging function in loggers.ts wraps its OpenTelemetry logger emissions inside bufferTelemetryEvent.

steps: In packages/core/src/telemetry/loggers.ts, wrap the logger emission and metric recording logic inside logChatCompression with bufferTelemetryEvent(() => { ... }).
Keep ClearcutLogger.getInstance(config)?.logChatCompressionEvent(event) outside bufferTelemetryEvent to match the standard pattern in loggers.ts.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: logChatCompression buffers its OpenTelemetry emission and metrics recording using bufferTelemetryEvent, preventing events from being dropped before SDK initialization.
verification_steps: Run vitest on packages/core/src/telemetry/loggers.test.ts to confirm existing and new tests pass.
Verify or add unit test cases in packages/core/src/telemetry/loggers.test.ts ensuring bufferTelemetryEvent is called during logChatCompression.
